  SCORE_CLASS = BASE_SCORE_CLASS(X)
  IF (IS_PASSING(X) = 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 2
  END IF
  IF (IS_AT_CAP(X) = 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 3
  END IF
  SCORE_CLASS = SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_AT_CAP(X)
  IF (NORMALIZE_SCORE(X) = 50) THEN
    IS_AT_CAP = 1
  ELSE
    IS_AT_CAP = 0
  END IF
  IS_AT_CAP = IS_AT_CAP
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION BASE_SCORE_CLASS(X)
  IF (NORMALIZE_SCORE(X) < 20) THEN
    BASE_SCORE_CLASS = 0
  ELSE
    BASE_SCORE_CLASS = 1
  END IF
  BASE_SCORE_CLASS = BASE_SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
